svg.title: Evolution — phases concept P2: the pond, its creatures to scale
svg.desc: The five single-cell forms as the player arrives in the pond, next to the pond's food, threats and giants. Code-drawn.
svg.text: · concept P2 — THE POND · who lives there, sized against you
Game scale: your form is 1× on arrival (all five forms arrive at the same size, for fair play). Real sizes are in the chart below.
ticket #782 · epic #761 · a concept for a decision, not a spec
dark-field language of sheets 01 and 04 · zero raster

a floor line, left to right by size · cyan = you · other colours = the pond
